supersedes.reason: Version 1 contained no real follow-up registry row and relied on test-only qualifying registration. Version 2 adds merged-main real reviewed-result import, display, recommendation, revisit enforcement, and idempotency evidence.

live_search_execution.pipeline_restart_evidence: Create and Run executed as separate installed CLI processes against the same immutable pending manifest; the later provenance-linked search preserved the prior completed history.

reviewed_follow_up_import.revisit_reason: No currently available TPF sector covers a predicted event and only two independent events exist; enable a new search only when additional event-covering observations are verified.
reviewed_follow_up_import.recommended_action: Monitor for or obtain additional event-covering observations; do not rerun the frozen tess_live_search_v1 batch and do not submit externally.
reviewed_follow_up_import.deferred_create_search_result: Requested one follow-up target but zero eligible candidates were available; no search was created.
